decision.reason: [ev-e6f81a6968bd] is a single changelog line saying the CLI's dependencies were updated to Kubernetes 1.33.2. It points to PR #5453 without giving a previous version or saying what changed for operators. The only other evidence, the compatibility table [ev-f88a947c0d4c], gives a cluster minimum of >= 1.32.0, not 1.33.2. That refuted P3's reading of this line as a cluster requirement change, so the line most likely describes an internal library bump. Neither excerpt says which environments are exposed or what happens if the operator does nothing, so applicability and consequence can't be written without the PR contents or an upgrade note.
